title: WHAM: World-grounded Humans with Accurate Motion

blocks.en: GT trajectory TRACE SLAHMR WHAM (Ours) P436.png

Figure 1. WHAM: World-grounded Humans with Accurate Motion. State-of-the-art methods like TRACE [45] and SLAHMR [55] fail to capture global 3D human trajectories accurately when given in-the-wild videos captured using a moving camera, producing implausible world-grounded motion (e.g., foot sliding). To address this, WHAM uses two novel strategies: (1) feature integration from 2D keypoints and pixels to reconstruct precise and pixel-aligned 3D human motion and (2) contact-aware trajectory recovery to place the human in a global coordinate system without foot sliding. Gray dots show the ground-truth global trajectory. See Supplemental Video.
blocks.zh: 图 1. WHAM: World-grounded Humans with Accurate Motion。在面对使用移动相机拍摄的真实场景（in-the-wild）视频时，像 TRACE [45] 和 SLAHMR [55] 这样的前沿方法无法准确捕捉全局 3D 人体轨迹，从而产生不切实际的基于世界坐标的运动（例如脚部滑动）。为解决这一问题，WHAM 采用了两种新颖策略：(1) 融合来自 2D 关键点和像素的特征，以重建精确且与像素对齐的 3D 人体运动；(2) 结合接触感知的轨迹恢复，将人体置于全局坐标系中且无脚部滑动。灰色圆点表示真实的全局轨迹（ground-truth global trajectory）。参见补充视频。

blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The estimation of 3D human motion from video has progressed rapidly but current methods still have several key limitations. First, most methods estimate the human in camera coordinates. Second, prior work on estimating humans in global coordinates often assumes a flat ground plane and produces foot sliding. Third, the most accurate methods rely on computationally expensive optimization pipelines, limiting their use to offline applications. Finally, existing videobased methods are surprisingly less accurate than singleframe methods. We address these limitations with WHAM (World-grounded Humans with Accurate Motion), which accurately and efficiently reconstructs 3D human motion in a global coordinate system from video. WHAM learns to lift 2D keypoint sequences to 3D using motion capture data and fuses this with video features, integrating motion context and visual information. WHAM exploits camera angular velocity estimated from a SLAM method together with human motion to estimate the body’s global trajectory. We combine this with a contact-aware trajectory refinement method that lets WHAM capture human motion in diverse conditions, such as climbing stairs. WHAM outperforms all existing 3D human motion recovery methods across multiple in-the-

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 引言

blocks.en: Our goal is to accurately estimate the 3D pose and shape of a person from monocular video. This is a longstanding problem and, while the field has made rapid progress, several key challenges remain. First, human motion should be computed in a consistent global coordinate system. Second, the method should be computationally efficient. Third, the results should be accurate, temporally smooth, detailed, natural looking, and have realistic foot-ground contact. Fourth, the capture should work with an arbitrary moving camera. These constraints need to be satisfied to make markerless human motion capture widely available for applications in gaming, AR/VR, autonomous driving, sports analysis, and human-robot interaction. We address these challenges with WHAM (World-grounded Humans with Accurate Motion) , which enables fast and accurate recovery of 3D human motion from a moving camera; see Fig. 1.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是从单目视频中准确估计人体的 3D 姿态与体型。这是一个长期存在的难题；尽管该领域已取得快速进展，但仍存在若干关键挑战。首先，人体运动应当在一个一致的全局坐标系中计算。其次，该方法在计算上应当高效。第三，结果应当准确、时序平滑、细节丰富、外观自然，并具有逼真的足-地接触。第四，动作捕捉应适用于任意移动的相机。只有满足这些约束条件，才能使无标记人体动作捕捉广泛应用于游戏、AR/VR、自动驾驶、体育分析以及人机交互。我们通过 WHAM（World-grounded Humans with Accurate Motion）应对这些挑战，该方法能够从移动相机中快速且准确地恢复 3D 人体运动；参见图 1。

blocks.en: It seems natural that, in estimating 3D humans from video, we should be able to exploit the temporal nature of video. Counter-intuitively, existing video-based methods for 3D
blocks.zh: 在从视频中估计 3D 人体时，我们理应能够利用视频的时序特性。然而反直觉的是，现有的用于 3D

blocks.en: human pose and shape (HPS) estimation [6, 15, 17, 30, 43, 52] are less accurate than the best single-frame methods [7, 14, 18, 21, 23, 25, 26, 60, 60]. This may be an issue of training data. There are large datasets of single images with ground-truth 3D human poses containing a diversity of body shapes, poses, backgrounds, lighting, etc. In contrast, video datasets with ground truth are much more limited.
blocks.zh: 人体姿态与体型（HPS）估计的基于视频的方法 [6, 15, 17, 30, 43, 52]，其精度反而低于最佳的单帧方法 [7, 14, 18, 21, 23, 25, 26, 60, 60]。这可能是训练数据的问题。包含真实 3D 人体姿态真值的单张图像数据集规模庞大，涵盖了体型、姿态、背景、光照等丰富的多样性；相比之下，具有真值的视频数据集则要有限得多。

blocks.en: To address this, WHAM leverages both the large-scale AMASS motion capture (mocap) dataset [32] and video datasets. Our key idea is to learn about 3D human motion from AMASS and then learn to fuse this information with temporal image cues from video, getting the best of both. Similar to previous work [61, 62], we use AMASS to generate synthetic 2D keypoints and ground-truth motion sequence pairs, from which we pretrain a motion encoder, which captures the motion context , and decoder that lifts sequences of 2D keypoints to sequences of 3D poses. Given the robustness of recent 2D keypoint detection models [54, 59], our pretrained model does a good job of predicting human pose from video.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题，WHAM 同时利用了大规模 AMASS 动作捕捉（mocap）数据集 [32] 和视频数据集。我们的核心思想是从 AMASS 中学习 3D 人体运动，然后学习将该信息与来自视频的时序图像线索相融合，从而兼取两者的优势。与先前的研究 [61, 62] 类似，我们使用 AMASS 生成合成 2D 关键点与真实运动序列的配对数据，并据此预训练一个用于捕获运动上下文的运动编码器，以及一个将 2D 关键点序列提升至 3D 姿态序列的解码器。得益于近期 2D 关键点检测模型 [54, 59] 的鲁棒性，我们的预训练模型在从视频预测人体姿态方面表现优异。

blocks.en: Keypoints alone, however, are too sparse for accurate 3D mesh estimation. To improve accuracy, we jointly train a feature integrator network that merges information from video and 2D-keypoint sequences. We use a pretrained image encoder from previous work [1, 7, 21, 25] and train the feature integrator using video datasets [11, 15, 33, 49]. This integration process supplements the motion context extracted from the sparse 2D keypoints with dense visual context, significantly improving the recovered pose and shape accuracy.
blocks.zh: 然而，仅凭关键点对于精确的 3D 网格估计而言过于稀疏。为了提高精度，我们联合训练了一个特征整合器网络，将来自视频和 2D 关键点序列的信息进行融合。我们采用了先前工作 [1, 7, 21, 25] 中的预训练图像编码器，并使用视频数据集 [11, 15, 33, 49] 来训练该特征整合器。这一整合过程利用稠密的视觉上下文补充了从稀疏 2D 关键点中提取的运动上下文，从而显著提高了恢复出的姿态与体型精度。

blocks.en: While the above approach produces accurate motion, we want this motion in global coordinates, unlike most previous methods that compute the body in camera coordinates. Estimating the global human trajectory is challenging when the camera is moving because the motions of the body and the camera are entangled. Recent work addresses this with optimization fitting based on a learned human motion prior and camera information from SLAM methods [20, 41, 55] or dense 3D scene information from COLMAP [28]. However, these methods are computationally expensive and far from real time. Recent regression-based methods are faster but either constrain the problem with static or known camera conditions [42, 61] or have temporal jitter and limited accuracy [45]. We tackle this challenge with two additional modules. First, we predict the global orientation and root velocity of the human from the sequence of 2D keypoints by training a global trajectory decoder . Specifically, we concatenate the camera’s angular velocity to the context and train the global trajectory decoder to recursively predict the current orientation and root velocity, effectively factoring camera motion from human motion. WHAM takes the camera’s angular velocity either from the output of a SLAM method or from a camera’s gyroscope when available.
blocks.zh: 尽管上述方法能够生成精确的运动，但与以往大多数在相机坐标系下计算身体的方法不同，我们希望该运动位于全局坐标系中。当相机处于移动状态时，估计人体全局轨迹极具挑战性，因为身体和相机的运动相互交织。近期的工作通过基于学习到的人体运动先验以及来自 SLAM 方法的相机信息 [20, 41, 55] 或来自 COLMAP [28] 的稠密 3D 场景信息进行优化拟合来解决这一问题。然而，这些方法计算成本高昂，远非实时。近期基于回归的方法速度更快，但要么将问题限制在静态或已知的相机条件下 [42, 61]，要么存在时序抖动且精度有限 [45]。我们通过两个额外模块来应对这一挑战。首先，我们通过训练一个全局轨迹解码器，从 2D 关键点序列中预测人体的全局朝向和根节点速度。具体而言，我们将相机的角速度与上下文拼接，并训练全局轨迹解码器递归预测当前的朝向和根节点速度，从而有效地将相机运动从人体运动中分解出来。WHAM 可以从 SLAM 方法的输出中获取相机角速度，或者在可用时直接从相机的陀螺仪中获取。

blocks.en: The above solution relies on knowledge of human motion
blocks.zh: 上述解决方案依赖于从

blocks.en: learned from AMASS. Therefore, it can fail to capture elevation changes when the surface is not flat, e.g. when ascending the stairs because AMASS has a limited amount of such data. To address this, we introduce foot contact as an additional explicit form of motion context. We train WHAM to predict the likelihood of foot-ground contact using estimated contact labels from both AMASS and 3D video datasets. We then train a trajectory refinement network that outputs an update to the root orientation and velocity based on the information about the foot contact/velocity. This refinement enables WHAM to accurately estimate human motion in a global coordinate system even when the terrain is not flat.
blocks.zh: AMASS 中学到的人体运动知识。因此，当表面不平坦时（例如爬楼梯，因为 AMASS 中此类数据有限），该方法可能无法捕获高度变化。为解决这一问题，我们引入了足部接触作为一种额外的显式运动上下文形式。我们利用来自 AMASS 和 3D 视频数据集的估计接触标签来训练 WHAM，以预测足-地接触的概率。随后，我们训练了一个轨迹优化网络，该网络根据足部接触/速度信息输出对根节点朝向和速度的更新量。这种细化使得 WHAM 即使在地形非平坦的情况下，也能在全局坐标系中准确估计人体运动。

blocks.en: WHAM has very low computational overhead because it is an on-line algorithm that recursively predicts the pose, shape, and global motion parameters. The network, excluding preprocessing (bounding box detection, keypoint detection, and person identification), runs at 200 fps, significantly faster than prior methods. Also, despite not using global optimization like [55], we obtain accurate 3D camera trajectories and global body motions with minimal drift. Through extensive comparisons on multiple in-the-wild datasets as well as detailed ablation studies, we find that WHAM achieves stateof-the-art (SOTA) accuracy on 3D human pose estimation as well as global trajectory estimation (see Fig. 1).
blocks.zh: WHAM 的计算开销极低，因为它是一种在线算法，可以递归预测姿态、体型和全局运动参数。该网络在不包括预处理（边界框检测、关键点检测和人物身份识别）的情况下运行速度可达 200 fps，显著快于先前的方法。此外，尽管没有使用像 [55] 那样的全局优化，我们仍获得了精确的 3D 相机轨迹和漂移极小的全局人体运动。通过在多个真实场景数据集上的广泛对比以及详细的消融实验，我们发现 WHAM 在 3D 人体姿态估计以及全局轨迹估计上均取得了最前沿（SOTA）的精度（参见图 1）。

blocks.en: In summary, in this paper we: (1) introduce the first approach to effectively fuse 3D human motion context and video context for 3D HPS regression; (2) propose a novel global trajectory estimation framework that leverages motion context and foot contact to effectively address foot sliding and enable the 3D tracking of people on non-planar surfaces; (3) efficiently perform HPS regression in global coordinates; (4) achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on multiple in-the-wild benchmark datasets (3DPW [49], RICH [10], EMDB [16]). WHAM is the first video-based method to outperform all image-based and video-based methods on per-frame accuracy while maintaining temporal smoothness.
blocks.zh: 综上所述，本文的主要贡献如下：(1) 首次提出了将 3D 人体运动上下文与视频上下文有效融合以进行 3D HPS 回归的方法；(2) 提出了一个新颖的全局轨迹估计框架，利用运动上下文和足部接触有效解决脚滑动问题，并实现在非平面表面上对人体的 3D 追踪；(3) 在全局坐标系下高效执行 HPS 回归；(4) 在多个真实场景基准数据集（3DPW [49]、RICH [10]、EMDB [16]）上取得了最前沿（SOTA）的性能。WHAM 是首个在保持时序平滑性的同时，在逐帧精度上超越所有基于图像和基于视频的方法的视频基方法。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Image-based 3D HPS Estimation. There are two broad classes of methods for recovering 3D HPS from images: model-free [22, 27, 34] and model-based [7, 12–14, 21, 25, 35, 36]. Here we focus on model-based methods, which estimate the low-dimensional parameters of a statistical body model [29, 37, 38, 53]. While early work explores optimization-based methods [2], here we focus on direct regression methods based on deep learning.
blocks.zh: 基于图像的 3D HPS 估计。从图像中恢复 3D HPS 主要有两大类方法：无模型（model-free）方法 [22, 27, 34] 和基于模型（model-based）的方法 [7, 12–14, 21, 25, 35, 36]。在此我们侧重于基于模型的方法，这类方法估计统计人体模型 [29, 37, 38, 53] 的低维参数。早期研究探索了基于优化的方法 [2]，而在此我们重点关注基于深度学习的直接回归方法。

blocks.en: Many existing methods follow the architecture of HMR [14], which uses a pretrained backbone to predict image features followed by a multilayer perceptron (MLP) that regresses SMPL [29] pose parameters from image features. Training such networks typically leverages paired images with SMPL parameters; these parameters are often pseudo-groundtruth (p-GT), estimated from 2D keypoints
blocks.zh: 许多现有方法遵循 HMR [14] 的架构，即使用预训练的骨干网络预测图像特征，随后通过多层感知机（MLP）从图像特征中回归 SMPL [29] 姿态参数。训练此类网络通常利用带有 SMPL 参数配对的图像数据；这些参数通常是通过 2D 关键点估计出的伪真值（p-GT）

blocks.en: [12, 21, 25, 35, 36]. Other architectures for HPS regression have also been proposed [7, 18, 19, 23, 24, 60]. None of these methods use video or estimate the body in global coordinates. While quite accurate, when these image-based models are applied independently to frames of a video sequence, the shape and pose can be temporally inconsistent. In contrast, WHAM effectively aggregates temporal information to provide frame-accurate and temporally-coherent 3D HPS estimation.
blocks.zh: [12, 21, 25, 35, 36]。此外，研究人员还提出了用于 HPS 回归的其他架构 [7, 18, 19, 23, 24, 60]。这些方法均未使用视频，也未在全局坐标系中估计人体。尽管它们相当精确，但当这些基于图像的模型独立应用于视频序列的各帧时，体型和姿态可能会在时间上不一致。相比之下，WHAM 有效地聚合了时序信息，以提供单帧准确且时序连贯的 3D HPS 估计。

blocks.en: Video-Based 3D HPS. Video-based methods typically encode temporal information by combining static features extracted by a backbone from each frame. HMMR [15] uses a convolutional encoder, while VIBE [17] and MEVA [30] employ recurrent neural networks. TCMR [6] divides sequences into past, future, and whole frames, aggregating information to strongly constrain the output with motion consistency. MPS-Net [52] uses attention to capture non-local motion context and a hierarchical architecture to aggregate temporal features. Both MAED [50] and GLoT [43] use transformer architectures [48] to encode videos. MAED encodes videos in both temporal (across frames) and spatial (within each frame) dimensions and leverages the kinematic tree to iteratively regress each joint angle. GLoT encodes long-term temporal correlations and refines local details by focusing on nearby frames. Despite integrating information across frames, all existing video-based methods have lower accuracy than the best single-frame methods.
blocks.zh: 基于视频的 3D HPS。基于视频的方法通常通过结合骨干网络从每帧中提取的静态特征来编码时序信息。HMMR [15] 使用卷积编码器，而 VIBE [17] 和 MEVA [30] 则采用循环神经网络。TCMR [6] 将序列划分为过去帧、未来帧和完整序列帧，聚合信息以运动一致性强有力地约束输出。MPS-Net [52] 利用注意力机制捕获非局部运动上下文，并使用分层架构来聚合时序特征。MAED [50] 和 GLoT [43] 均使用 Transformer 架构 [48] 对视频进行编码。MAED 在时序（跨帧）和空间（每帧内部）两个维度上对视频进行编码，并利用运动学树迭代回归各个关节角度。GLoT 对长期时序相关性进行编码，并通过聚焦邻近帧来细化局部细节。尽管整合了跨帧信息，但所有现有的基于视频的方法精度均低于最佳的单帧方法。

blocks.en: Given limited video training data with ground truth SMPL poses, several single-frame methods infer a mesh from 2D/3D keypoints [5, 8, 31, 34, 39] and use the keypoints as a proxy for training. Another set of approaches exploits 3D mocap data, which is plentiful [32], to train a network to lift 2D joints to 3D poses, which are used as a proxy for ground truth 3D. MotionBERT [62] synthesizes 2D keypoints through orthographic projection to learn a unified motion representation. ProxyCap [61] projects synthetic 3D keypoints into virtual cameras using a heuristic camera pose distribution. Despite benefiting from the scale of mocap datasets, these approaches do not fully utilize the visual information available in the video at test time. Here, we propose a combined network architecture and training strategy that leverages both proxy representations of human pose (lifting) and visual context extracted from video.
blocks.zh: 鉴于带有真实 SMPL 姿态真值的视频训练数据有限，若干单帧方法从 2D/3D 关键点推断网格 [5, 8, 31, 34, 39]，并将关键点作为训练的代理。另一类方法则利用极其丰富的 3D 动作捕捉数据 [32] 来训练网络将 2D 关节提升至 3D 姿态，并以此作为 3D 真值的代理。MotionBERT [62] 通过正交投影合成 2D 关键点以学习统一的运动表征。ProxyCap [61] 使用启发式相机位姿分布将合成的 3D 关键点投影到虚拟相机中。尽管受益于动作捕捉数据集的规模，但这些方法在测试时并未充分利用视频中可用的视觉信息。在此，我们提出了一种组合网络架构和训练策略，同时利用人体姿态的代理表征（提升）以及从视频中提取的视觉上下文。

blocks.en: Global 3D Motion Estimation with Dense Sensors. Several methods augment video data with other sensors to estimate 3D HPS in world coordinates. The 3DPW dataset [49] employs pre-calibrated body-worn inertial sensors and a handheld camera to jointly optimize the camera and human motion in challenging environments. Similarly, the EMDB dataset [16] uses electromagnetic sensors with an RGB-D camera, enabling accurate human motion capture in the world. While body-worn sensors aid global human motion reconstruction, they are intrusive, require cooperation, and
blocks.zh: 基于稠密传感器的全局 3D 运动估计。有若干方法利用其他传感器来扩充视频数据，以估计世界坐标系下的 3D HPS。3DPW 数据集 [49] 采用预先校准的穿戴式惯性传感器和手持相机，在具有挑战性的环境中联合优化相机与人体运动。类似地，EMDB 数据集 [16] 将电磁传感器与 RGB-D 相机结合使用，实现了在真实世界中精确捕捉人体运动。尽管穿戴式传感器有助于全局人体运动的重建，但它们具有侵入性、需要受试者配合，且

blocks.en: do not help with archival video. BodySLAM++ [9] uses an optimization method with a visual-inertial sensor, comprising stereo cameras and an IMU. In contrast, we use a standard monocular camera, balancing accessibility and accuracy without using specialized equipment. While WHAM can take the camera gyro as input, this is not required. Monocular Global 3D Human Trajectory Estimation. Estimating the global human trajectory from a monocular dynamic camera is challenging. Previous work relies on learned prior distributions of human motion to separate human motion from camera motion. GLAMR [58] computes the global trajectory based on a predicted and infilled 3D motion sequence and optimizes it across multiple individuals in the scene. However, since GLAMR does not consider camera motion cues, the output trajectory may be noisy when the camera is rotating. SLAHMR [55] and PACE [20] use off-the-shelf SLAM algorithms [46, 47] and jointly optimize the camera and human motion to minimize the negative loglikelihood of a learned motion prior [40]. While they achieve good results, their optimization approach is computationally expensive. TRACE [45] is a pure regression method that utilizes optical flow as a motion cue and estimates multiple people at once, but lacks temporal consistency. GloPro [42] regresses the uncertainty of the global human motion in real-time, but requires known camera poses. In contrast, WHAM leverages both explicit and implicit prior knowledge of human motion and efficiently reconstructs accurate and temporally coherent 3D human motion in world coordinates.

blocks.en: 3.3. Training

Pretraining on AMASS. We train in two stages: (1) pretraining with synthetic data, and (2) fine-tuning with real data (Fig. 3). The objective of the pretraining stage is to teach the motion encoder to extract motion context from the input 2D keypoint sequence. The motion and trajectory decoders then map this motion context to the corresponding 3D motion and global trajectory spaces (i.e. they lift the encoding to 3D). We use the AMASS dataset [32] to generate an extensive set of synthetic pairs consisting of sequences of 2D keypoints together with the ground truth SMPL parameters.
blocks.zh: 在 AMASS 上的预训练。我们分两个阶段进行训练：(1) 使用合成数据进行预训练，以及 (2) 使用真实数据进行微调（图 3）。预训练阶段的目标是让运动编码器学会从输入的 2D 关键点序列中提取运动上下文。随后，运动和轨迹解码器将该运动上下文映射到相应的 3D 运动和全局轨迹空间（即它们将编码提升到 3D）。我们使用 AMASS 数据集 [32] 生成大量合成数据对，由 2D 关键点序列及对应的 SMPL 参数真值组成。

blocks.en: To synthesize 2D keypoints from AMASS, we create virtual cameras onto which we project 3D keypoints derived from the ground truth mesh. Unlike MotionBERT [62] and ProxyCap [61], which use static cameras for keypoint projection, we employ dynamic cameras that incorporate both rotational and translational motion. This choice has two main motivations. First, it accounts for the inherent differences between human motions captured in static and dynamic camera setups. Second, it enables the learning of a camera-agnostic motion representation, from which the trajectory decoder can reconstruct the global trajectory. We also augment the 2D data with noise and masking. For details of the synthetic generation process see Sup. Mat.
blocks.zh: 为了从 AMASS 合成 2D 关键点，我们创建了虚拟相机，并将从真实网格推导出的 3D 关键点投影到虚拟相机中。与使用静态相机进行关键点投影的 MotionBERT [62] 和 ProxyCap [61] 不同，我们采用了兼具旋转和平移运动的动态相机。这一选择有两个主要动因：首先，它考虑了在静态和动态相机设置下所捕获人体运动之间的内在差异；其次，它使得模型能够学习到与相机无关的运动表示，轨迹解码器可据此重建全局轨迹。我们还通过添加噪声和遮挡来增强 2D 数据。关于合成生成过程的细节，参见补充材料（Sup. Mat.）。

blocks.en: Fine-tuning on Video Datasets. Starting with the pretrained network, we fine-tune WHAM on four video datasets: 3DPW [49], Human3.6M [11], MPI-INF-3DHP [33], and InstaVariety [15]. For the human mesh recovery task, we supervise WHAM on ground-truth SMPL parameters from AMASS and 3DPW, 3D keypoints from Human3.6M and MPI-INF3DHP, and 2D keypoints from InstaVariety. For the global trajectory estimation task, we use AMASS, Human3.6M, and MPI-INF-3DHP. Additionally, during training we experiment with adding BEDLAM [1], a large synthetic dataset with realistic video and ground truth SMPL parameters.
blocks.zh: 在视频数据集上的微调。从预训练网络出发，我们在四个视频数据集上对 WHAM 进行微调：3DPW [49]、Human3.6M [11]、MPI-INF-3DHP [33] 和 InstaVariety [15]。对于人体网格恢复任务，我们在来自 AMASS 和 3DPW 的 SMPL 参数真值、来自 Human3.6M 和 MPI-INF3DHP 的 3D 关键点以及来自 InstaVariety 的 2D 关键点上对 WHAM 进行监督。对于全局轨迹估计任务，我们使用 AMASS、Human3.6M 和 MPI-INF-3DHP。此外，在训练过程中，我们还尝试加入了 BEDLAM [1]，这是一个包含逼真视频和 SMPL 参数真值的大型合成数据集。

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate WHAM on three in-the-wild benchmarks: 3DPW [49], RICH [10], and EMDB [16]. Following previous work [1, 6, 14, 17, 21, 25, 30], we perform the evaluation in camera coordinates. The estimated global trajectory is evaluated on a subset of EMDB ( EMDB 2 ) for which they provide ground truth global motion with dynamic cameras (used for evaluation). We also test on new sequences captured using an iPhone with the gyroscope. See Sup. Mat. for more details on the datasets and iPhone results.
blocks.zh: 数据集。我们在三个真实场景（in-the-wild）基准数据集上评估 WHAM：3DPW [49]、RICH [10] 和 EMDB [16]。遵循先前的工作 [1, 6, 14, 17, 21, 25, 30]，我们在相机坐标系下进行评估。估计的全局轨迹在 EMDB 的一个子集（EMDB 2）上进行评估，该子集提供了带有动态相机的全局运动真值（用于评估）。我们还在使用带有陀螺仪的 iPhone 采集的新序列上进行了测试。有关数据集和 iPhone 结果的更多细节，参见补充材料（Sup. Mat.）。

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. To evaluate the accuracy of 3D human pose and shape estimation, we compute Mean Per Joint Position Error (MPJPE), Procrustes-aligned MPJPE (PA-MPJPE), and Per Vertex Error (PVE) measured in millimeters ( mm ). We compute Acceleration error (Accel, in m/s2 )1 to measure the inter-frame smoothness of the reconstructed motion. We also evaluate the motion reconstruction and trajectory estimation accuracy in the world-frame. Following previous work [20, 55], we split sequences into smaller segments of 100 frames and align each output segment with the ground-truth data using the first two frames (W-MPJPE100) or the entire segment (WA-MPJPE100) in mm . These previous metrics give an unrealistic picture of 3D performance as they do not measure drift over long sequences. Therefore, we also evaluate the error over the entire trajectory after the rigid alignment and measure Root Translation Error (RTE in %) normalized by the actual displacement of the person. We also assess the jitter of the motion in the world coordinate system in 10 m/s3 and foot sliding during the contact (FS in mm ).
blocks.zh: 评估指标。为了评估 3D 人体姿态与体型估计的准确性，我们计算以毫米（mm）为单位测量的每关节平均位置误差（MPJPE）、Procrustes 对齐后的 MPJPE（PA-MPJPE）以及每顶点误差（PVE）。我们计算加速度误差（Accel，单位为 m/s2）1 以衡量重建动作的帧间平滑度。我们还在世界坐标系下评估动作重建和轨迹估计的准确性。遵循先前的工作 [20, 55]，我们将序列划分为 100 帧的较短片段，并使用前两帧（W-MPJPE100）或整个片段（WA-MPJPE100）将每个输出片段与真值数据进行对齐（以 mm 为单位）。这些以往的指标无法衡量长序列上的漂移，因而给出了不切实际的 3D 性能表现。因此，我们还在刚性对齐后评估整个轨迹上的误差，并测量通过人体实际位移进行归一化后的根关节平移误差（RTE，以 % 为单位）。我们还评估了世界坐标系下的动作抖动（单位为 10 m/s3）以及接触期间的脚部滑动（FS，以 mm 为单位）。

blocks.en: 4.1. 3D Human Motion Recovery
blocks.zh: 4.1. 3D 人体动作恢复

blocks.en: Per-frame accuracy. Table 1 presents a comprehensive comparison of WHAM and the existing state-of-the-art per-frame and video-based methods across three benchmark datasets [10, 16, 49]. Because none of the methods are exposed to data from RICH or EMDB during training, results on these datasets are indicative of each method’s ability to generalize. WHAM (Res), WHAM (HR), and WHAM (ViT) correspond to different architectures for the pretrained image encoders, derived from SPIN (ResNet-50) [21], CLIFF (HRNet-W48) [1, 25], and HMR2.0 (ViT-H/16) [7], respectively. Not surprisingly, WHAM (HR) is more accurate than WHAM (Res), while the transformer-based version, WHAM (ViT), is the most accurate. The backbone matters, with WHAM (ViT) outperforming all previous methods on all per-frame metrics (MPJPE, PA-MPJPE, and PVE) on all benchmarks. Even with the simplest ResNet backbone, WHAM (Res) outperforms every method except for ReFit on RICH.
blocks.zh: 逐帧准确率。表 1 展示了 WHAM 与现有的最先进逐帧和基于视频的方法在三个基准数据集 [10, 16, 49] 上的全面对比。由于所有方法在训练期间均未接触过来自 RICH 或 EMDB 的数据，因此在这些数据集上的结果反映了各方法的泛化能力。WHAM (Res)、WHAM (HR) 和 WHAM (ViT) 分别对应预训练图像编码器的不同架构，分别衍生自 SPIN (ResNet-50) [21]、CLIFF (HRNet-W48) [1, 25] 和 HMR2.0 (ViT-H/16) [7]。不出所料，WHAM (HR) 比 WHAM (Res) 更准确，而基于 Transformer 的版本 WHAM (ViT) 则是最准确的。主干网络至关重要，WHAM (ViT) 在所有基准数据集上的所有逐帧指标（MPJPE、PA-MPJPE 和 PVE）上均优于以往所有方法。即便采用最简单的 ResNet 主干网络，WHAM (Res) 在 RICH 上除了 ReFit 之外也优于其他所有方法。

One possible reason for this is that, unlike ReFit, we did not finetune the image encoder during training to limit training time.

blocks.en: Inter-frame smoothness. We also evaluate the inter-frame smoothness using the acceleration error. Compared with state-of-the-art per-frame methods [1, 7, 23, 25], WHAM has significantly lower acceleration error. This indicates that WHAM reconstructs smooth and more plausible 3D human motion across frames while not sacrificing high per-frame accuracy. On the other hand, when compared to recent temporal methods [6, 43, 52], WHAM exhibits comparable or slightly higher acceleration error. However, we observe that these video-based methods tend to over-smooth the human motion, resulting in lower accuracy on per-frame metrics.
blocks.zh: 帧间平滑度。我们还利用加速度误差来评估帧间平滑度。与最先进的逐帧方法 [1, 7, 23, 25] 相比，WHAM 的加速度误差显著更低。这表明 WHAM 能够在跨帧重建平滑且更合理 3D 人体动作的同时，不牺牲较高的逐帧准确率。另一方面，与近期的时序方法 [6, 43, 52] 相比，WHAM 的加速度误差相当或略高。然而，我们观察到这些基于视频的方法往往会对人体动作过度平滑，从而导致逐帧指标上的准确率较低。

blocks.en: To provide intuition for these numbers, we qualitatively compare WHAM with TCMR [6] and GLoT [43] in Fig. 4. While producing smooth results, TCMR and GLoT fail to capture the bending of the left knee when the subject is ascending the stairs, while WHAM more accurately reconstructs the 3D human pose.

blocks.en: 4.3. Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3. 消融实验

blocks.en: To provide further insight into our approach, we conduct ablation studies to analyze the contribution of each component to the performance. As shown in Table 4, our entire system (WHAM) outperforms the different variants of WHAM that ablate a single component. To be specific, we first observe that adding feature integration improves both motion and global trajectory estimation accuracy when compared with an ablated version without feature integration (w/o FI ). Similarly, the removal of the pretraining on the 2D-to-3D lifting task using AMASS [32] (w/o lifting) shows significant performance degradation. WHAM also outperforms the ablation of the Neural Initialization (w/o NI), particularly in the MPJPE metric. blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: WHAM is a new method to recover accurate 3D human motion in global coordinates from a moving camera more efficiently and accurately than the state-of-the-art approaches. Our approach leverages the AMASS dataset to train a network to recursively lift 2D sequences of keypoints to sequences of 3D SMPL parameters. But keypoints alone lack valuable information about the body and its movement. Consequently, we integrate image context information over time and learn to combine it with the motion context to better estimate human body shape and pose. Additionally, our method takes an estimate of the camera angular velocity, which can either be computed from a SLAM method or from the camera’s gyro when available. Finally, we combine all this information with an estimate of foot contact to recover the 3D human motion in global coordinates from a monocular video sequence. WHAM significantly outperforms the existing state-of-the-art methods (both image-based and video-based) on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks in both 3D HPS and the world-coordinate trajectory estimation accuracy. Because of its speed and accuracy, WHAM provides a foundation for in-the-wild motion capture applications.
blocks.zh: WHAM 是一种在移动相机视角下、于全局坐标系中恢复精确 3D 人体动作的新方法，比现有前沿方法更为高效和精确。我们的方法利用 AMASS 数据集训练了一个网络，递归地将 2D 关键点序列提升为 3D SMPL 参数序列。然而，仅靠关键点缺少关于人体及其运动的有价值信息。因此，我们在时序上融合了图像上下文信息，并学习将其与动作上下文结合，以更好地估计人体体型与姿态。此外，我们的方法还利用了估计的相机角速度，该角速度既可以通过 SLAM 方法计算获得，也可以在有条件时直接由相机的陀螺仪提供。最后，我们将所有这些信息与脚部接触估计相结合，从而从单目视频序列中恢复出全局坐标系下的 3D 人体动作。在极具挑战性的真实自然场景（in-the-wild）基准测试中，WHAM 在 3D HPS 以及世界坐标系轨迹估计精度上均显著优于现有的前沿方法（包括基于单张图像和基于视频的方法）。凭借其速度与精度，WHAM 为野外真实场景动作捕捉应用奠定了基础。

blocks.en: Limitations and future directions: WHAM learns about human motion from AMASS, limiting generalization to motions that are out of distribution. While we employ random masking as part of our data synthesis process, our generating approach mainly assumes the scenario where the full body is within the field of view. See Sup. Mat. for more details.
blocks.zh: 局限性与未来方向：WHAM 从 AMASS 中学习人体动作，这限制了其对分布外动作的泛化能力。虽然我们在数据合成过程中采用了随机掩码，但我们的生成方法主要假设了全身均处于视场范围内的场景。更多细节请参阅补充材料（Sup. Mat.）。

blocks.en: WHAM opens up many directions for future work. For example, while we use SLAM to estimate the camera’s angular velocity, SLAM could also provide camera intrinsics and extrinsics as well as information about the 3D scene that could be used to enforce consistency between the scene and the human. While WHAM is an online method, designed for real-time applications, it could also initialize an optimization-based post-processing akin to bundle adjustment, which would optimize the camera, scene, and human motion together. Furthermore, a real-time and phone-based implementation of WHAM should be feasible.
blocks.zh: WHAM 为未来的工作开辟了诸多方向。例如，虽然我们利用 SLAM 来估计相机的角速度，但 SLAM 还可以提供相机的内参和外参以及 3D 场景信息，这些信息可用于约束场景与人体之间的一致性。尽管 WHAM 是一种专为实时应用设计的在线方法，但它也可以用于初始化类似于光束法平差（bundle adjustment）的基于优化的后处理过程，从而联合优化相机、场景和人体动作。此外，在手机端实现实时运行的 WHAM 应当是可行的。

blocks.en: A. Synthetic data generation
blocks.zh: A. 合成数据生成

blocks.en: To address the scarcity of the video data with paired 3D ground truth, we pretrain WHAM on an extensive number of synthetic 2D keypoint sequences for which we have the ground truth 3D poses. In this section, we describe the process of data synthesis from AMASS [32].
blocks.zh: 为了解决带有配对 3D 真值的视频数据稀缺的问题，我们在大量具有对应真值 3D 姿态的合成 2D 关键点序列上对 WHAM 进行了预训练。在本节中，我们介绍了基于 AMASS [32] 进行数据合成的过程。

blocks.en: 2D keypoint sequence synthesis. During training, we sample sequences of SMPL poses of length L = 81 from AMASS. Then, similar to MEVA [30], we uniformly upsample or downsample the frames to speed up or down the motion by up to 50% of the original speed. Furthermore, we apply a random root rotation ∆Γ ∼U (0◦ , 360◦ ) to the axis that is vertical to the ground plane and Gaussian noise to the shape parameter ∆ β ∼N (0 , 0 . 1). Given the augmented SMPL sequence, we extract 3D keypoints that correspond to the MS-COCO keypoints and add 3D noise modeled following previous work [44]. Finally, we apply a random mask with the average probability of p = 0 . 15 to the 3D keypoints and project them onto the virtual camera as described below.
blocks.zh: 2D 关键点序列合成。在训练期间，我们从 AMASS 中采样长度为 L = 81 的 SMPL 姿态序列。随后，类似于 MEVA [30]，我们对帧进行均匀上采样或下采样，以在原始速度的基础上加快或减慢动作最高达 50%。此外，我们绕垂直于地平面的轴施加随机根关节旋转 ∆Γ ∼U (0◦ , 360◦ )，并对形状参数添加高斯噪声 ∆ β ∼N (0 , 0 . 1)。在得到增强后的 SMPL 序列后，我们提取出对应于 MS-COCO 关键点的 3D 关键点，并依照先前工作 [44] 建模并添加 3D 噪声。最后，我们以平均概率 p = 0 . 15 对这些 3D 关键点应用随机掩码，并按照下文所述将它们投影到虚拟相机中。

blocks.en: Contact label generation. The goal of generating a contact label is to train the motion decoder to detect the footground contact accurately. Previous work [61] uses both the velocity and height of the feet to generate contact labels. However, in order to generalize our approach to arbitrary ground conditions such as slopes or stairs, we only use foot velocity to compute the ground truth contact labels, similar to TransPose [56]. We use the heel and toe vertices of each foot to define foot-ground contact and compute the probability as below:
blocks.zh: 接触标签生成。生成接触标签的目的是训练动作解码器准确检测足部与地面的接触。先前的工作 [61] 同时利用足部的速度和高度来生成接触标签。然而，为了使我们的方法能够泛化到任意地面条件（例如斜坡或楼梯），类似于 TransPose [56]，我们仅使用足部速度来计算真值接触标签。我们利用每只脚的脚跟和脚尖顶点来定义足地接触，并如下计算接触概率：

blocks.en: 1 p ˆ ( t ) = 1 + e α ( v ( t ) −vt ) /vt .
We set the threshold velocity vt = 1cm / frame and the coefficient α = 5.
blocks.zh: 我们将阈值速度设为 vt = 1cm / frame，系数设为 α = 5。

blocks.en: Camera motion synthesis. We begin with generating the initial pose of the virtual camera, followed by the modeling of the camera motion. We model the initial roll and pitch angles of the camera using Gaussian distributions:
blocks.zh: 相机运动合成。我们首先生成虚拟相机的初始位姿，随后对相机运动进行建模。我们使用高斯分布对相机的初始横滚角（roll）和俯仰角（pitch）进行建模：

blocks.en: Here, we do not model the initial yaw angle since it is already handled by the random SMPL root rotation ∆Γ.
blocks.zh: 在此，我们不对初始偏航角（yaw）进行建模，因为随机 SMPL 根关节旋转 ∆Γ 已经对其进行了处理。

blocks.en: Subsequently, we sample the initial camera translation, using a mix of uniform and normal distributions, to capture the ground-truth 3D pose in the camera coordinates:
blocks.zh: 随后，我们结合均匀分布与正态分布对相机的初始平移进行采样，以在相机坐标系中捕获 3D 真值姿态：

blocks.en: Here, d = w · Tz/ 2 f is the maximum displacement of the camera to capture the 3D keypoints within the field of view, R(0) is the initial camera pose, t(0) is the initial human translation, w is the image size, and f is the focal length. Next, we sample the magnitude of change in the camera’s extrinsics with the Gaussian distributions:
blocks.zh: 在此，d = w · Tz/ 2 f 是相机为了在视场内捕获 3D 关键点所允许的最大位移，R(0) 是相机初始位姿，t(0) 是人体初始平移，w 是图像尺寸，f 是焦距。接下来，我们使用高斯分布对相机外参的变化幅度进行采样：

blocks.en: Finally, we interpolate the extrinsics and construct the camera’s dynamic path. Here, we sample the time stamp with 20% of noise, instead of uniform sampling, to model the non-linear camera motion.
blocks.zh: 最后，我们对外参进行插值以构建相机的动态路径。在此，我们不对时间戳进行均匀采样，而是加入 20% 的噪声进行采样，以模拟相机的非线性运动。

blocks.en: We use 6.7M frames in total and uniformly sample them during the synthetic data generation.
blocks.zh: 我们总共使用了 670 万（6.7M）帧，并在合成数据生成过程中对其进行均匀采样。

blocks.en: B. Datasets
blocks.zh: B. 数据集

blocks.en: In this section, we illustrate the datasets we use for training and testing our method.
blocks.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍用于训练和测试我们方法的数据集。

blocks.en: Human3.6M [11] is an indoor dataset containing individuals performing 15 distinct actions captured by both a motioncapture (mocap) system and 4 calibrated video cameras. The ground truth 3D keypoint locations are provided by the mocap. Following previous work [6, 17, 43, 52], we use 5 subjects (S1, S5, S6, S7, and S8) to train our network after downsampling the mocap data to 25 fps.
blocks.zh: Human3.6M [11] 是一个室内数据集，包含由动作捕捉（mocap）系统和 4 台标定摄像机采集的、不同受试者执行 15 种不同动作的数据。动捕系统提供了 3D 关键点真值位置。遵循先前的工作 [6, 17, 43, 52]，我们将动捕数据下采样至 25 fps，并使用 5 名受试者（S1、S5、S6、S7 和 S8）来训练我们的网络。

blocks.en: MPI-INF-3DHP [33] is a multi-view and markerless dataset containing individuals performing various ranges of motion with corresponding ground-truth 3D keypoint locations. To train the network, we use the training set of the dataset, containing 8 subjects and 16 videos per subject.
blocks.zh: MPI-INF-3DHP [33] 是一个多视角且无标记点（markerless）的数据集，包含受试者执行各种动作范围的记录及相应的 3D 关键点真值位置。为了训练网络，我们使用了该数据集的训练集，其中包含 8 名受试者，每名受试者包含 16 段视频。

blocks.en: InstaVariety [15] is a large-scale in-the-wild video dataset with large variations in subjects, motion, and environment. The dataset contains pseudo-ground-truth 2D keypoints detected by OpenPose [4]. We train our method on the training split of the dataset.
blocks.zh: InstaVariety [15] 是一个大规模真实自然场景（in-the-wild）视频数据集，涵盖了受试者、动作和环境的多样变化。该数据集包含由 OpenPose [4] 检测出的伪真值（pseudo-ground-truth）2D 关键点。我们在该数据集的训练划分（training split）上训练我们的方法。

blocks.en: 3DPW [49] is an in-the-wild video dataset containing ground truth 3D pose captured by a hand-held camera and 13 bodyworn inertial sensors. We use the train, validation, and test splits of 3DPW for training, validating, and testing our method.
blocks.zh: 3DPW [49] 是一个真实自然场景下的视频数据集，包含由手持相机和 13 个穿戴式惯性传感器捕获的 3D 真值姿态。我们使用 3DPW 的训练集、验证集和测试集划分分别来训练、验证和测试我们的方法。

blocks.en: RICH [10] is a large-scale multi-view dataset captured in both indoor and outdoor environments. RICH provides the ground truth SMPL-X [38] parameters. Following previous work [1], we use the test split of the dataset to evaluate our method on 3D pose estimation accuracy.
blocks.zh: RICH [10] 是一个在室内和室外环境中采集的大规模多视角数据集。RICH 提供了真值 SMPL-X [38] 参数。遵循先前的工作 [1]，我们使用该数据集的测试划分来评估我们方法在 3D 姿态估计精度上的表现。

blocks.en: EMDB [16] is a recently captured dataset that uses a dynamic camera and body-worn electromagnetic (EM) sensors. EMDB provides ground-truth SMPL parameters as well as the global trajectory of the individuals in a global coordinate system. We use two distinct test splits, EMDB 1 and EMDB 2 , to evaluate the performance on 3D pose and shape estimation ( EMDB 1 ) and global trajectory estimation ( EMDB 2 ).
blocks.zh: EMDB [16] 是近期采集的数据集，它采用动态相机和穿戴式电磁（EM）传感器。EMDB 提供了真值 SMPL 参数以及受试者在全局坐标系中的全局轨迹。我们使用两个不同的测试划分 EMDB 1 和 EMDB 2，分别评估 3D 姿态与体型估计（EMDB 1）以及全局轨迹估计（EMDB 2）的性能。

blocks.en: BEDLAM [1] is a recently proposed large-scale synthetic dataset. BEDLAM introduces realistic modeling of diverse clothing, hair, motion, skin tones, and scene environments to synthesize videos. BEDLAM contains 1 million video frames for individuals with ground truth SMPL/SMPL-X parameters. We optionally use the train split of BEDLAM to train the network.
blocks.zh: BEDLAM [1] 是近期提出的一个大规模合成数据集。BEDLAM 对多样的服装、发型、动作、肤色以及场景环境进行了逼真建模以合成视频。BEDLAM 包含 100 万帧具有真值 SMPL/SMPL-X 参数的人物视频帧。我们选择性地使用 BEDLAM 的训练划分来训练网络。

blocks.zh: 最后，我们利用接触期间的足部速度引入足部滑动损失：

Here, vf(t) is the world-coordinate foot velocity, and ⊙ denotes the masking operation of foot contact based on the ground truth contact probability p∗(t) .

blocks.en: D. Neural-network initialization
blocks.zh: D. 神经网络初始化

blocks.en: Uni-directional RNNs introduce the challenge of differing learning objectives between the initial frames and subsequent ones due to the initialization state. Specifically, in traditional RNNs, the initialization state is typically padded with zeros, resulting in the first frame primarily relying on the input signal. In contrast, the subsequent frames are trained to capitalize on both the input signal and information transferred from the past. To resolve the disparity in learning objectives, we use a neural initialization network, as proposed by [57], to predict h 0 ,E and h 0 ,D from the 0-th frame pose, instead of using zero-padding. During the training, we use pseudoground-truth 3D pose [35] for the video datasets that do not have the SMPL parameter annotation [11, 15, 33]. Note that we do not supervise our network on the pseudo labels. At test time, we use the pose and shape predicted by a single-frame regressor as the initial state.
blocks.zh: 由于初始化状态的存在，单向 RNN 会在初始帧与后续各帧之间引入学习目标不同的挑战。具体而言，在传统 RNN 中，初始化状态通常以零填充，导致第一帧主要依赖于输入信号。相比之下，后续各帧在训练中则同时利用输入信号和过去传递的信息。为了解决这种学习目标上的差异，我们采用 [57] 提出的神经初始化网络，根据第 0 帧姿态来预测 h 0 ,E 和 h 0 ,D，而不是使用零填充。在训练期间，对于没有 SMPL 参数标注的视频数据集 [11, 15, 33]，我们使用伪真值 3D 姿态 [35]。需要注意的是，我们并未在伪标签上监督我们的网络。在测试时，我们使用单帧回归器预测的姿态和体型作为初始状态。

blocks.en: E. Qualitative evaluation of contact estimation
blocks.zh: E. 接触估计的定性评估

blocks.en: In the main paper, we show the quantitative effect of the contact-aware trajectory refinement unit. To supplement this with more intuitive visualization, we provide qualitative results in Fig. 7. As shown in the figure, WHAM without the trajectory refinement unit induces significant foot sliding during the contact. Conversely, WHAM reconstructs a more feasible trajectory based on its contact estimation.

blocks.en: F. Run-time cost
blocks.zh: F. 运行时开销

blocks.en: While the core WHAM network presented here runs at 200fps, it relies on the input of several other methods. Here we compute the run time of each module required by our framework on the EMDB dataset [16]. The inference speed of all methods was computed on a single A100 GPU. We exclude running SLAM in this analysis as it can be obviated if we use gyroscope data (though real-time SLAM methods exist). As shown in Table 5, our full method, with preprocessing steps, runs at around 9 fps with online inference (i.e., a batch size of 1 and no lag), and around 50 fps when run in batch mode (with resulting lag). We compare the core runtime of WHAM with SLAHMR [55], excluding bounding box detection, person identification, and keypoints detection, for which there are real-time solutions. In this condition, WHAM takes 5 seconds (202 fps) for 1000 frames. Specifically, WHAM takes 4.3 seconds (237 fps) for image feature extraction and 0.7 seconds (1431 fps) to regress the motion and global trajectory. This is significantly faster than SLAHMR which takes 260 minutes ( < 0.1 fps) per 1000 frames.
blocks.zh: 尽管此处介绍的 WHAM 核心网络运行速度达 200 fps，但它依赖于其他若干方法的输入。在此，我们在 EMDB 数据集 [16] 上计算了我们框架所需的各个模块的运行时间。所有方法的推理速度均在单张 A100 GPU 上测得。在本分析中我们排除了运行 SLAM，因为如果使用陀螺仪数据则可以省去 SLAM（尽管现存实时的 SLAM 方法）。如表 5 所示，包含预处理步骤的完整方法在在线推理模式下（即批大小为 1 且无延迟）运行速度约为 9 fps，而在批处理模式下（会产生相应延迟）运行速度约为 50 fps。我们将 WHAM 的核心运行时与 SLAHMR [55] 进行了对比（不包括边界框检测、人体识别和关键点检测，因为这些环节已有实时解决方案）。在此条件下，处理 1000 帧时 WHAM 仅耗时 5 秒（202 fps）。具体而言，WHAM 用于图像特征提取耗时 4.3 秒（237 fps），回归动作和全局轨迹耗时 0.7 秒（1431 fps）。这显著快于 SLAHMR 每 1000 帧需要 260 分钟（< 0.1 fps）的运行速度。

blocks.en: G. Discussions of limitation
blocks.zh: G. 局限性讨论

blocks.en: In Fig. 8, we demonstrate exemplar cases when WHAM fails to capture the global motion of the person. Since the datasets we used for training WHAM on global trajectory estimation do not contain people riding skateboards or bicycles, WHAM does not capture the global trajectory in these scenarios. Furthermore, our contact estimation only applies to the feet, thus, WHAM fails to capture ground contact of the human body other than the feet, resulting in physically infeasible body support (floating hands) or sliding of the contact points.
